canada.title: Chow shakes up city hall leadership, taps former Liberal MP for housing
canada.summary: Mayor Olivia Chow is again turning down a post on the Toronto police board while opting to stick with the same roster of deputy mayors as when she finished her first term.
canada.outlet: CP24 + Global News (CP), CBC News, CityNews

canada.title: New Brunswick adopts HPV testing for cervical cancer, Nova Scotia urged to follow
canada.summary: Nova Scotia's Official Opposition is calling on the province to quickly adopt HPV testing for cervical cancer and transition away from the traditional Pap test.

canada.title: Almost half of women in B.C. report intimate partner violence: StatsCan
canada.summary: The study showed 47 per cent of B.C. women reported experiencing intimate partner violence. That figure, calculated from 2025 data, has held steady since the last report, which examined numbers gathered in 2018.

canada.title: Specialist 'deeply disappointed' by N.S. delays on cervical cancer screening
canada.summary: The specialist who developed a proposal to change the way Nova Scotia screens for cervical cancer says he's deeply disappointed the province will be one of the last in the country to start HPV testing, while the Department of Health and Wellness says the process is more complicated than it sounds.

canada.title: Fredericton’s Lincoln Heights will be home to new K-8 school
canada.summary: The Lincoln Heights neighbourhood in Fredericton will be the site of a new school for kindergarten to Grade 8. The province said the $60 million project should open its doors to students in September 2030.

canada.title: Former colleges and universities minister refuses to answer OSAP questions
canada.summary: Ontario’s former minister of colleges and universities, who presided over the file for three years until 2024, is refusing to answer questions about a growing Ontario Student Assistance Program scandal.
canada.outlet: CP24 + CityNews + Global News + CBC News (CP)

canada.title: Trouble in paradise: Edson volleyball team returns home after being stranded in Hawaii for 5 days
canada.summary: Getting stuck in Hawaii for a few extra days might sound like a dream, but it turned into a travel headache this week for nearly 30 Alberta teens and their families. They all finally returned home Thursday morning, after being stranded for five days.

canada.title: Canada commits $6.2M to 2028 North American Indigenous Games

canada.title: Quebecers suspected of murder among Canada's 25 most wanted fugitives
canada.summary: Three men suspected of murder in Quebec have been added to the list of Canada's top 25 most wanted fugitives. The updated list was unveiled on Thursday in Toronto as part of the BOLO (Be On the Lookout) program.

canada.title: Inuvik man sentenced to over 3 years for impaired driving causing death in 2021 crash
canada.summary: Malcolm Nerysoo, 30, was found guilty earlier this year in connection with a 2021 crash near Inuvik that killed 38-year-old Kristine McLeod.

canada.title: Weight balance, fuel concerns highlighted in report on deadly 2025 Manitoba plane crash
canada.summary: An investigation into a plane crash that killed four in northern Manitoba last year has raised concerns about weight balance and fuel storage on a flight that almost didn't happen.

canada.title: Blue Bombers fire head coach Mike O'Shea after 12 seasons
canada.summary: The Winnipeg Blue Bombers announced Thursday they have parted ways with longtime head coach Mike O'Shea.

canada.title: Alberta bill would ban some bike lanes, let transportation minister remove others
canada.summary: Alberta’s government is proposing to ban future bike lanes that remove or restrict motor-vehicle traffic and give itself the power to remove some existing bike lanes.

canada.title: Montreal byelections crucial for rebuilding NDP, party leader Avi Lewis says
canada.summary: Avi Lewis said a win in either Montreal byelection would be "incredible" but he sees these contests — and the four others taking place across Canada on Dec. 7 — as a means to continue building up the NDP's support base for the next general election.
canada.outlet: CBC News + CP24 + Global News (CP), CP24

canada.title: Anthropic needs rapid growth to keep up spending, as Canadian AI sector heats up
canada.summary: Anthropic's investor documents warn the company needs to increase sales to pay for its data centre leases and infrastructure. At the same time, the company says it needs to plan its data centre investments years in advance, without knowing whether its customers will be there for the long term.

canada.title: Former top Mountie to be sentenced for assault on teen in B.C. court
